boundary.title: Native WIMSE Tigrbl Auth T0 through T3

features.body:
T0: Check URI syntax, normalization, and invalid identifiers against draft-ietf-wimse-identifier-04.

T1: Verify that WIC and WIT use the same parser and interpret the same identity consistently.

T2: Exercise both consumers from clean wheel installs without SPIFFE packages or SPIRE services.
features.description: Deliver WIMSE workload identifiers under the linked normative requirements.
features.title: WIMSE workload identifiers

features.body:
T0: Check workload URI SAN extraction and cardinality. Include a permitted DNS SAN.

T1: Parse signed fixtures into concrete WICs and verify certificate-to-identity consistency.

T2: Consume a native wimse URI WIC through the public profile from an isolated wheel install.
features.description: Deliver WIMSE WIC certificate profile under the linked normative requirements.
features.title: WIMSE WIC certificate profile

features.body:
T0: Check expected-peer identity and trust-domain configuration.

T1: Verify chain, certificate status, expected peer identity, and DNS name where applicable.

T2: Perform a real handshake with native WICs. Verify authenticated identity handoff and rejection for wrong domain, anchor, peer identity, and certificate status.
features.description: Deliver WIMSE WIC peer authentication over mTLS under the linked normative requirements.
features.title: WIMSE WIC peer authentication over mTLS

features.body:
T0: Check draft-pinned claims, workload identifier, token type, and confirmation JWK.

T1: Verify signed WITs against configured domain anchors. Reject wrong keys, invalid claims, and expiry.

T2: Run the installed WIT verifier with a configured trust source and demonstrate correct acceptance and rejection across signing-key rotation.
features.description: Deliver WIMSE WIT credential verification under the linked normative requirements.
features.title: WIMSE WIT credential verification

features.body:
T0: Check proof type, audience, lifetime, and exact WIT hash fields.

T1: Verify the proof signature and algorithm against the verified WIT confirmation key. Reject mismatched keys, audiences, and WIT hashes.

T2: Authenticate HTTP requests through the composed WIT/WPT verifier. Exercise replay handling and retain accepted and rejected results.
features.description: Deliver WIMSE WPT request authentication under the linked normative requirements.
features.title: WIMSE WPT request authentication

features.description: Issue signed WITs and present WIT-bound proofs in outbound HTTP requests through the public Tigrbl Auth profiles.
features.title: WIMSE WIT issuance and WPT request presentation
